    k = int(input[ptr])

        ptr += 1
        y = int(input[ptr]) - 1
        ptr += 1

                        walls.add((i, j))

    # Then count unique walls adjacent to those cells
    output = []

        q = deque()
        q.append((x, y))
        visited[x][y] = True
        reachable = set()
        reachable.add((x, y))

        while q:
            i, j = q.popleft()
            for di, dj in directions:
                ni, nj = i + di, j + dj
                if 0 <= ni < n and 0 <= nj < m and grid[ni][nj] == '.' and not visited[ni][nj]:
                    visited[ni][nj] = True
                    q.append((ni, nj))

        # Count unique walls adjacent to reachable cells
        count = 0
        seen_walls = set()
        for (i, j) in reachable:
            for di, dj in directions:
                ni, nj = i + di, j + dj
                if 0 <= ni < n and 0 <= nj < m and grid[ni][nj] == '*':
                    wall_key = (i, j)  # The wall is between (i,j) and (ni,nj)
                    if wall_key not in seen_walls:
                        seen_walls.add(wall_key)
                        count += 1
        output.append(str(count))

    print(' '.join(output))
